effects.value: While raging, make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each subsequent turn; gain one level of exhaustion when the rage ends

name: Frenzy
description: While raging, you can enter a frenzy that allows you to make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after the turn you enter the frenzy. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion.

effects.value: While raging, immune to charmed and frightened conditions; suspend existing effects for the rage's duration

name: Mindless Rage
description: While raging, you cannot be charmed or frightened, and any existing charm or fear effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

effects.value: Action; one creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier); repeat the action on subsequent turns to extend the effect; ends if the creature is out of sight or more than 60 feet away at the end of its turn

name: Intimidating Presence
description: You can use an action to frighten one creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you. The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw against a DC based on your Charisma; you can use the feature again on subsequent turns, but it ends if the creature moves out of sight or finishes its turn more than 60 feet away.

effects.value: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack against it

name: Retaliation
description: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature.

effects.value: Can cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals without material components

name: Spirit Seeker
description: You gain the ability to cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals, without requiring material components.

effects.value: Choose Bear (resistance to all damage except psychic), Eagle (opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and Dash as a bonus action), or Wolf (allies have advantage on melee attack rolls against hostile creatures within 5 feet of you)

name: Totem Spirit
description: You choose a totem spirit and gain its benefit while raging. The Bear, Eagle, and Wolf options grant different defensive, mobility, or ally-support benefits.

effects.value: Choose Bear (double carrying capacity and advantage on Strength checks to push, pull, lift, or break objects), Eagle (see up to 1 mile clearly and discern fine details; dim light does not impose disadvantage on Wisdom checks relying on sight), or Wolf (track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace)

name: Aspect of the Beast
description: You choose an animal aspect that grants a special benefit, such as enhanced carrying capacity, keen sight, or improved tracking and stealth.

effects.value: Can cast Commune with Nature as a ritual

name: Spirit Walker
description: You can cast Commune with Nature as a ritual, allowing you to commune with nature spirits and learn information about the surrounding area.

effects.value: Choose Bear (while raging, a creature within 5 feet that is hostile to you has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Bear-attuned barbarian), Eagle (while raging, you can fly at your current walking speed, but fall if you end your turn airborne), or Wolf (while raging, use a bonus action to knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it with a melee weapon attack)

name: Totemic Attunement
description: You choose a totem spirit and gain a powerful benefit while raging. The Bear, Eagle, and Wolf options provide different ways to control enemies or protect allies.

effects.value: spiked armor
While raging and wearing spiked armor, deal 1d4 piercing damage to a creature you grapple at the start of your turn
While raging and wearing spiked armor, make a melee weapon attack with the armor spikes as a bonus action; hit deals 1d4 piercing damage plus Strength modifier

name: Battlerager Armor
description: You gain the ability to use spiked armor as a weapon and make a special attack with its spikes as a bonus action while raging. You also deal piercing damage with the armor when you successfully grapple a creature.

name: Reckless Abandon
description: When you use Reckless Attack while raging, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1).

effects.value: While raging, take the Dash action as a bonus action

name: Battlerager Charge
description: You can take the Dash action as a bonus action while raging.

effects.value: When a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack while you are wearing spiked armor, it takes 3 piercing damage

name: Spiked Retribution
description: When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, it takes piercing damage from your spiked armor.

effects.value: While raging, first creature hit on each turn is marked until the start of your next turn; it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you, and those creatures have resistance to its damage

name: Ancestral Protectors
description: While raging, the first creature you hit with an attack on each of your turns is marked by ancestral spirits. That creature has disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you, and those targets have resistance to its damage.

effects.value: Reaction; reduce damage to a visible creature within 30 feet by 2d6 while raging; reduction increases to 3d6 at barbarian level 10 and 4d6 at barbarian level 14

name: Spirit Shield
description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage while you are raging, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 2d6. The reduction increases at higher barbarian levels.

effects.value: Cast Augury or Clairvoyance without material or somatic components; Wisdom is the spellcasting ability

name: Consult the Spirits
description: You can cast Augury or Clairvoyance without material or somatic components, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. Once you cast either spell this way, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

effects.value: When Spirit Shield reduces damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the damage prevented

name: Vengeful Ancestors
description: When you use Spirit Shield to reduce damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount of damage prevented by the reaction.

effects.value: 10-foot aura while raging; choose Desert (each other creature in the aura takes 2 fire damage), Sea (one creature you can see in the aura takes 1d6 lightning damage; Dexterity save for half), or Tundra (one creature of your choice in the aura gains 2 temporary hit points)
Desert damage and Tundra temporary hit points increase at barbarian levels 5, 10, 15, and 20; Sea damage increases at levels 10 and 15

name: Storm Aura
description: While raging, you emanate an aura extending 10 feet from you. You choose a desert, sea, or tundra environment, gaining its aura effect whenever you enter a rage and at the start of each of your turns while raging.

name: Storm Soul
description: Your chosen storm environment grants you a special benefit, and you gain resistance to a damage type associated with that environment. The benefit depends on whether you chose Desert, Sea, or Tundra.

effects.value: While raging, choose creatures within your Storm Aura; they gain your Storm Soul damage resistance

name: Shielding Storm
description: While raging, creatures of your choice have resistance to the damage type associated with your Storm Soul, provided they are within your Storm Aura.

name: Raging Storm
description: Your storm aura gains an additional effect determined by your chosen environment.

effects.value: First creature hit with a weapon attack on each turn while raging takes 1d6 + half your barbarian level (rounded down) radiant or necrotic damage

name: Divine Fury
description: While raging, the first creature you hit with a weapon attack on each of your turns takes extra radiant or necrotic damage. The extra damage increases as you gain barbarian levels.

effects.value: Spells that restore you to life require no material components when cast on you

name: Warrior of the Gods
description: Spells that restore you to life, such as Raise Dead, do not require material components when used on you.

name: Fanatical Focus
description: Once while raging, if you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new result.

effects.value: Up to 10 chosen creatures within 60 feet gain advantage until the start of your next turn

name: Zealous Presence
description: As a bonus action, you unleash a battle cry that grants up to ten creatures of your choice within 60 feet advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. Once used, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

effects.value: While raging at 0 hit points, remain conscious and ignore death from failed death saves; die if rage ends while still at 0 hit points

name: Rage Beyond Death
description: While raging, having 0 hit points does not knock you unconscious, and you do not die from failed death saving throws. You still suffer the normal effects of taking damage at 0 hit points, and you die if your rage ends while you have 0 hit points.

effects.value: Choose bite (1d8 piercing; once per turn when below half hit points, regain hit points equal to proficiency bonus), claws (1d6 slashing; when attacking with a claw, make one additional claw attack as part of the same action), or tail (1d8 piercing; reaction to add 1d8 to AC against one attack that would hit you)

name: Form of the Beast
description: When you enter a rage, you can transform and manifest a natural weapon: bite, claws, or tail. Each option grants a different attack benefit, and the bite can restore hit points under specific conditions.

effects.value: While raging, bite form grants a swimming speed equal to walking speed and ability to breathe underwater; claw form grants climbing speed equal to walking speed; tail form grants a standing long jump and high jump distance increased by 10 feet
Natural weapons count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage

name: Bestial Soul
description: Your natural weapons count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. Depending on your current form, you also gain climbing, swimming, or jumping enhancements.

effects.value: On hit with natural weapon while raging, target makes Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier); on failure, use reaction to make melee attack against another creature you choose or take 2d12 psychic damage

name: Infectious Fury
description: When you hit a creature with your natural weapons while raging, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of two effects: use its reaction to attack another creature you choose, or take psychic damage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

effects.value: When entering rage, choose up to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1) willing creatures within 30 feet; you gain 5 temporary hit points for each creature that accepts
Once per turn, when you or an ally within 5 feet of a creature in the hunt hits it, deal extra damage equal to 1d6

name: Call the Hunt
description: When you enter a rage, you can choose creatures within 30 feet to join the hunt. You gain temporary hit points for each creature that joins, and once per turn you can deal extra damage to a creature hit by you or an ally.

effects.value: Action; sense the location of spells and magic items within 60 feet until the end of your next turn

name: Magic Awareness
description: As an action, you can open your awareness to magic within 60 feet until the end of your next turn. You learn the location of any spell or magic item, and can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

effects.value: Roll on the Path of Wild Magic surge table when entering rage; saving throw DC equals 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier

name: Wild Surge
description: When you enter a rage, you roll on the Wild Magic table to determine the magical effect produced. If the effect requires a saving throw, its DC equals 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier.

effects.value: Touch one creature; grant 1d3 bonus to attack rolls and ability checks for 10 minutes, or restore one expended spell slot of 1st–3rd level (maximum slot level based on target's proficiency bonus)

name: Bolstering Magic
description: As an action, touch one creature and grant it a bonus to attack rolls and ability checks for 10 minutes, or restore one expended spell slot of a specified level. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

effects.value: Reaction when taking damage or failing a saving throw while raging; replace current Wild Surge effect with a new roll on the Wild Magic table

name: Unstable Backlash
description: When you take damage or fail a saving throw while raging, you can use your reaction to roll on the Wild Magic table and replace your current Wild Surge effect.

effects.value: Roll twice on Wild Magic table and choose either result; may end current Wild Surge effect and replace it with a new roll

name: Controlled Surge
description: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic table while raging, you can roll twice and choose which effect occurs. You can also choose to end your current Wild Surge effect and replace it with a new one.

effects.value: three skills of your choice

name: Bonus Proficiencies
description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

effects.value: Reaction; expend one Bardic Inspiration die to subtract its result from a creature's attack roll, ability check, or damage roll; creature must be within 60 feet and unable to hear you or be immune to being charmed

name: Cutting Words
description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, you can use your reaction and expend a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract the roll from its result.

effects.value: Learn two spells from any class spell list; each must be of a level you can cast and counts as a bard spell

name: Additional Magical Secrets
description: You learn two spells of your choice from any class's spell list. Each chosen spell must be of a level you can cast, and the spells count as bard spells for you.

effects.value: Expend one Bardic Inspiration use and add the Bardic Inspiration die to an ability check; may decide after rolling the d20 but before the DM says whether the check succeeds or fails

name: Peerless Skill
description: When you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and add the Bardic Inspiration die to the check.

effects.value: medium armor
shields
martial weapons

name: Bonus Proficiencies
description: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

effects.value: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can add it to a weapon damage roll or use its reaction to add it to AC against one attack after seeing the attack roll but before knowing whether it hits or misses

name: Combat Inspiration
description: A creature with one of your Bardic Inspiration dice can add it to a weapon damage roll or use its reaction to add it to its AC against an attack.

effects.value: Make two attacks when taking the Attack action

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

effects.value: After casting a bard spell with your action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action

name: Battle Magic
description: When you use your action to cast a bard spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

effects.value: Bonus action; choose up to Charisma modifier creatures within 60 feet that can see you; each gains temporary hit points equal to 2 × Bardic Inspiration die and may use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks

name: Mantle of Inspiration
description: You can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration as a bonus action to grant temporary hit points to a number of creatures you choose within 60 feet. Each affected creature can immediately use its reaction to move without provoking opportunity attacks.

effects.value: Perform for at least 1 minute; choose a number of humanoids who watched and listened up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1); each makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is charmed for 1 hour; once used, unavailable again until a short or long rest

name: Enthralling Performance
description: After performing for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to charm humanoids who watched and listened to you. The effect lasts for 1 hour, or until the creature takes damage, you attack it, or it witnesses you attacking or damaging one of its allies.

effects.value: Bonus action to cast Command without a spell slot; for 1 minute, cast Command as a bonus action on each of your turns without a spell slot; creatures charmed by you automatically fail their saving throws against the Command you cast with this feature

name: Mantle of Majesty
description: You can cast Command as a bonus action without expending a spell slot, and you take on an appearance of unearthly beauty for 1 minute. Once used, you cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

effects.value: Bonus action; lasts 1 minute; first time each turn a creature attacks you, it makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC or the attack misses and it must choose a new target or waste the attack

name: Unbreakable Majesty
description: As a bonus action, you assume a majestic presence for 1 minute. The first time a creature makes an attack roll against you on each turn, it must make a Charisma saving throw or its attack misses, and it must choose a new target or lose the attack.

effects.value: medium armor
scimitar
Use a proficient melee weapon as a spellcasting focus for bard spells

name: Bonus Proficiencies
description: You gain proficiency with medium armor and the scimitar. If you are already proficient with a melee weapon, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your bard spells.

effects.value: Choose Dueling (+2 damage with a melee weapon wielded in one hand and no other weapons) or Two-Weapon Fighting (add ability modifier to damage of the second attack)

name: Fighting Style
description: You adopt either the Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting style.

effects.value: When taking Attack action, walking speed increases by 10 feet until end of turn; on a weapon hit, expend Bardic Inspiration to add the die to damage and choose Defensive Flourish (add die to AC until start of next turn), Mobile Flourish (push target up to 5 + die roll feet and move up to walking speed toward it), or Slashing Flourish (deal die-roll damage to another creature within 5 feet of you)

name: Blade Flourish
description: When you take the Attack action, your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the turn. When a weapon attack hits, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die to add it to the damage and choose a defensive, mobile, or slashing flourish.

effects.value: Make two attacks when taking the Attack action

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

effects.value: Use a d6 for Blade Flourish without expending Bardic Inspiration

name: Master's Flourish
description: Whenever you use Blade Flourish, you can roll a d6 instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.

effects.value: Expend Bardic Inspiration on a weapon hit to deal 2d6 psychic damage; increases to 3d6 at bard level 5, 5d6 at level 10, and 8d6 at level 15

name: Psychic Blades
description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die to deal additional psychic damage. The extra damage increases as you gain bard levels.

effects.value: Spend at least 1 minute speaking privately to a humanoid; it makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is frightened for 1 hour; once used, unavailable again until a short or long rest

name: Words of Terror
description: You can frighten a humanoid by speaking to it privately for at least 1 minute. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw or is frightened of you or another creature of your choice for 1 hour, until attacked or damaged, or until it witnesses its allies being attacked or damaged.

effects.value: Reaction when a humanoid dies within 30 feet; capture its shadow; use an action to transform into the dead humanoid's appearance and gain surface-level information; disguise lasts 1 hour or until ended

name: Mantle of Whispers
description: When a humanoid dies within 30 feet of you, you can capture its shadow and use it to assume its appearance. You gain access to information the humanoid would freely share with a casual acquaintance, and the disguise lasts for 1 hour.

effects.value: Whisper to one humanoid within 30 feet; it makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is frightened and charmed for 8 hours; ends early if you or your allies attack or damage it

name: Shadow Lore
description: You can whisper a phrase to a humanoid that frightens and charms it, allowing you to manipulate it. The effect lasts for 8 hours or until you or your allies attack or damage the target.

name: Note of Potential
description: Whenever you give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die, you can create a mote of potential that provides an additional benefit when the die is used, depending on whether it is used for an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

effects.value: Animate one eligible item as a friendly construct; uses your bonus action to command it; it has AC 16, hit points equal to 10 + five times your bard level, 30-foot flying speed with hover, and a force-infused slam attack

name: Animating Performance
description: As an action, you can animate one Large or smaller nonmagical item that is not being worn or carried, creating a Dancing Item under your control for up to 1 hour. You can use this feature once per long rest or expend a 3rd-level or higher spell slot to use it again.

effects.value: Performance of Creation creates a number of items equal to Charisma modifier (minimum 2); no gold-piece value limit; each item must be within the feature's size limit

name: Creative Crescendo
description: Your Performance of Creation can create more than one item at a time, and the gold-piece limit of the created items is removed. You can create a number of nonmagical items equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum two), provided they are within the size limit.

effects.value: Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 on Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Deception) checks

name: Silver Tongue
description: Whenever you make a Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Deception) check, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

effects.value: Bonus action; expend Bardic Inspiration and subtract the die roll from one creature's next saving throw before the start of your next turn

name: Unsettling Words
description: As a bonus action, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die and subtract the number rolled from the next saving throw the target makes before the start of your next turn.

effects.value: If a creature's roll fails after adding your Bardic Inspiration die, it retains the die and does not expend it

name: Unfailing Inspiration
description: When a creature adds one of your Bardic Inspiration dice to an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and the roll fails, it can keep the die instead of expending it.

effects.value: Action; choose creatures up to Charisma modifier within 60 feet; they understand your speech for 1 hour regardless of language

name: Universal Speech
description: As an action, choose a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier within 60 feet. For 1 hour, each chosen creature can understand you, regardless of language.

effects.value: Reaction; when an inspired creature within 60 feet succeeds on a roll using your Bardic Inspiration die, grant a Bardic Inspiration die to another creature you can see within 60 feet

name: Infectious Inspiration
description: When a creature within 60 feet adds one of your Bardic Inspiration dice to an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and succeeds, you can use your reaction to give a different creature a Bardic Inspiration die without expending a use.

effects.value: Learn Guidance; it does not count against bard cantrips known and has a range of 60 feet when cast by you

name: Guiding Whispers
description: You learn the Guidance cantrip, which does not count against your number of bard cantrips known. It has a range of 60 feet when you cast it.

effects.value: Use a candle, crystal ball, skull, spirit board, or tarokka deck as a bard spellcasting focus; when casting a bard spell through it that deals damage or restores hit points, add 1d6 to one damage or healing roll

name: Spiritual Focus
description: You can use a special object as a spellcasting focus for your bard spells. When you cast a bard spell through the focus that deals damage or restores hit points, roll a d6 and gain a bonus to one damage or healing roll equal to the number rolled.

effects.value: Bonus action; expend Bardic Inspiration and roll on Spirit Tales table; the tale's effect is delivered when a creature holding the inspiration die uses it

name: Tales from Beyond
description: You can reach out to spirits and expend a Bardic Inspiration use to roll on the Spirit Tales table, producing a magical tale whose effect can be invoked by a creature holding the inspiration die.

effects.value: During a short or long rest, conduct a 1-hour séance with a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus; learn one divination or necromancy spell from any class list of a level equal to the number of participating creatures or lower; spell counts as bard spell until next long rest

name: Spirit Session
description: You can conduct a spiritual séance during a short or long rest, learning one divination or necromancy spell from any class list. The spell counts as a bard spell for you until you finish your next long rest.

effects.value: Roll twice on Spirit Tales table and choose result; alternatively, choose a specific tale by number

name: Mystical Connection
description: Whenever you roll on the Spirit Tales table, you can roll twice and choose which effect to use. You can also invoke a specific tale by choosing its number rather than rolling.

effects.value: No additional feature

name: (No additional subclass feature)
description: All College of Swords features are listed above.

effects.value: two of Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion
Learn two languages of your choice
Double proficiency bonus for ability checks using the two skills selected with this feature

name: Blessings of Knowledge
description: You learn two languages of your choice and gain proficiency in two skills from Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for ability checks using either chosen skill.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Knowledge Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Action; gain proficiency in one skill or tool for 10 minutes

name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to gain proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice for 10 minutes.

effects.value: Choose one creature within 60 feet; it makes a Wisdom save; on failure, read its surface thoughts for 1 minute while it remains within 60 feet; during this time, cast Suggestion on it without a spell slot, ending the effect

name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to read a creature's surface thoughts and potentially cast Suggestion on it without expending a spell slot.

effects.value: +Wisdom_modifier

name: Potent Spellcasting
description: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

effects.value: Object reading takes at least 1 minute and reveals previous owner and significant events; area reading takes 10 minutes and reveals events from up to 100 years ago; once used, unavailable until a short or long rest

name: Visions of the Past
description: You can call up visions of the past related to an object you hold or your immediate surroundings. Object readings reveal its previous owner and significant events, while area readings reveal events from the past.

effects.value: heavy armor

name: Bonus Proficiency
description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Life Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

name: Disciple of Life
description: When you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

effects.value: Action; distribute healing among creatures within 30 feet; cannot heal a creature above half its hit point maximum or affect undead and constructs

name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to restore hit points to creatures within 30 feet, distributing a pool of hit points equal to five times your cleric level. This feature cannot restore a creature above half its hit point maximum.

name: Blessed Healer
description: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than you, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

effects.value: Once per turn, add 1d8 radiant damage to a weapon hit; increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: Use the maximum possible result for every die rolled to restore hit points with a spell

name: Supreme Healing
description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore hit points with a spell, you instead use the highest number possible for each die.

effects.value: Learn Light; it does not count against cleric cantrips known

name: Bonus Cantrip
description: You learn the Light cantrip if you do not already know it. It does not count against the number of cleric cantrips you know.

effects.value: Reaction when a visible creature within 30 feet attacks you; impose disadvantage on that attack roll

name: Warding Flare
description: When attacked by a creature you can see within 30 feet, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on its attack roll by creating a flash of light. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier, with a minimum of once, and regain all uses after a long rest.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Light Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Action; dispel magical darkness within 30 feet; hostile creatures within 30 feet make Constitution saves, taking 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage on failure or half on success

name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to dispel magical darkness and deal radiant damage to hostile creatures within 30 feet. Creatures that fail a Constitution saving throw take 2d10 + your cleric level radiant damage, or half as much on a success.

effects.value: Use Warding Flare when a visible creature within 30 feet attacks a creature other than you

name: Improved Flare
description: You can use Warding Flare when a creature you can see within 30 feet attacks another creature other than you.

effects.value: +Wisdom_modifier

name: Potent Spellcasting
description: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

effects.value: Action; emit bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for another 30 feet for 1 minute; enemies in bright light have disadvantage on saves against spells dealing fire or radiant damage

name: Corona of Light
description: You can use an action to emit an aura of sunlight for 1 minute. Enemies within 60 feet have disadvantage on saving throws against spells that deal fire or radiant damage.

effects.value: Learn one druid cantrip; it counts as a cleric cantrip for you
One of Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival

name: Acolyte of Nature
description: You learn one druid cantrip of your choice and gain proficiency in one of Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

effects.value: heavy armor

name: Bonus Proficiency
description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Nature Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Action; beasts and plant creatures within 30 feet make Wisdom saves or become charmed for 1 minute; effect ends early if a creature takes damage

name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to charm beasts and plants within 30 feet that fail a Wisdom saving throw. Charmed creatures are friendly toward you and other creatures you designate for 1 minute or until they take damage.

effects.value: Reaction; grant resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage to you or a creature within 30 feet for that instance of damage

name: Dampen Elements
description: When you or a creature within 30 feet takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to grant that creature resistance to that instance of damage.

effects.value: Once per turn, add 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage to a weapon hit; increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: Bonus action to command creatures charmed by Charm Animals and Plants

name: Master of Nature
description: You can command creatures charmed by your Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants as a bonus action on your turn.

effects.value: martial weapons
heavy armor

name: Bonus Proficiencies
description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Tempest Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet hits you; Dexterity save or take 2d8 lightning or thunder damage, half on success

name: Wrath of the Storm
description: When a creature within 5 feet hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 2d8 lightning or thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success; uses equal your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

effects.value: When rolling lightning or thunder damage, use Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage

name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath

effects.value: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, push it up to 10 feet away

name: Thunderbolt Strike
description: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can also push it up to 10 feet away from you.

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: Gain flying speed equal to walking speed while outdoors and not underground

name: Stormborn
description: You gain a flying speed equal to your current walking speed whenever you are not underground or indoors.

effects.value: One willing creature touched has advantage for 1 hour or until you use this feature again

name: Blessing of the Trickster
description: As an action, you can touch a willing creature other than yourself to give it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. The blessing lasts for 1 hour or until you use this feature again.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Trickery Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Action; create illusory duplicate within 30 feet for 1 minute; move it up to 30 feet as a bonus action; gain advantage on attack rolls against a creature when you and the duplicate are within 5 feet of it; cast cleric spells as though in duplicate's space

name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
description: You create an illusory duplicate of yourself for up to 1 minute. You can cast spells as though you were in the duplicate's space, and both you and the duplicate gain special benefits when attacking a creature near it.

effects.value: Action; become invisible until end of next turn or until you attack or cast a spell

name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to become invisible as an action until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell.

effects.value: Once per turn, add 1d8 poison damage to a weapon hit; increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 poison damage. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: Create up to four duplicates with Invoke Duplicity; move any number of them up to 30 feet as a bonus action, with each remaining within 120 feet of you

name: Improved Duplicity
description: You can create up to four duplicates with Invoke Duplicity instead of one. As a bonus action, you can move any number of them up to 30 feet, to a maximum distance of 120 feet from you.

heavy armor

effects.value: After taking the Attack action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action

name: War Priest
description: When you use the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses after a long rest.

name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
description: When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You can choose to use this feature after seeing the roll but before the DM says whether it hits or misses.

effects.value: +10 to an attack roll made by a creature within 30 feet as a reaction

name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
description: When a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant it a +10 bonus to the roll, using your Channel Divinity.

effects.value: Once per turn, add 1d8 damage of the weapon's type to a weapon hit; increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons

name: Avatar of Battle
description: You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

effects.value: Learn two wizard cantrips; they count as cleric cantrips
Arcana

name: Arcane Initiate
description: You learn two wizard cantrips of your choice. They count as cleric cantrips for you, and you also gain proficiency in Arcana.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Arcana Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Action; one celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within 30 feet makes a Charisma save or is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage; at cleric level 5 or higher, a turned creature with challenge rating at or below the specified threshold is banished for 1 minute if not on its native plane

name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Abjuration
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to present your holy symbol and force a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within 30 feet to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

effects.value: When healing a creature with a spell of 1st level or higher, end one spell affecting it if that spell's level is no higher than the healing spell's slot level

name: Spell Breaker
description: When you restore hit points to a creature with a spell of 1st level or higher, you can also end one spell of your choice affecting that creature if the spell's level is equal to or lower than the level of the spell slot used.

effects.value: +Wisdom_modifier

name: Potent Spellcasting

effects.value: Choose one wizard spell each of levels 6, 7, 8, and 9; always have them prepared as domain spells

name: Arcane Mastery
description: You choose four wizard spells, one each from spell levels 6, 7, 8, and 9. You add them to your list of domain spells and always have them prepared.

effects.value: martial weapons

description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons.

effects.value: Learn one necromancy cantrip from any spell list; when casting a necromancy cantrip that targets only one creature, target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other

name: Reaper
description: You learn one necromancy cantrip from any spell list. When you cast a necromancy cantrip that normally targets only one creature, you can target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Death Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: On a melee attack hit, deal extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level

name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
description: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal additional necrotic damage.

effects.value: Your necrotic damage ignores resistance to necrotic damage

name: Inescapable Destruction
description: Your ability to channel negative energy becomes more potent. Necrotic damage you deal ignores resistance to necrotic damage.

effects.value: Once per turn, add 1d8 necrotic damage to a weapon hit; increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: Necromancy spells of 1st–5th level that target one creature can target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other

name: Improved Reaper
description: When you cast a necromancy spell of 1st through 5th level that targets only one creature, you can have the spell target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other.

effects.value: heavy armor
smith's tools

name: Bonus Proficiencies
description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Forge Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: +1 to one nonmagical suit of armor or one simple or martial weapon until next long rest

name: Blessing of the Forge
description: At the end of a long rest, you can touch one nonmagical suit of armor or simple or martial weapon and make it magical, granting it a +1 bonus to AC or attack and damage rolls until the end of your next long rest.

effects.value: One-hour ritual; create one nonmagical item containing metal worth up to 100 gp; expend metal of equal value; item must fit on a surface no larger than 10 feet square

name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to conduct a one-hour ritual that creates a nonmagical item containing metal. The item's value cannot exceed 100 gp, and the ritual requires metal equal to the item's value.

effects.value: Resistance to fire damage
+1 while wearing heavy armor

name: Soul of the Forge
description: You gain resistance to fire damage and a +1 bonus to AC while wearing heavy armor.

effects.value: Once per turn, add 1d8 fire damage to a weapon hit; increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 fire damage. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: Immunity to fire damage
While wearing heavy armor, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

name: Saint of Forge and Fire
description: You gain immunity to fire damage and, while wearing heavy armor, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

effects.value: You have advantage
When healing a creature at 0 hit points with a spell, use the maximum result for each healing die

name: Circle of Mortality
description: You have advantage on death saving throws, and when you use a spell to restore hit points to a creature at 0 hit points, treat any healing dice as having rolled their maximum values.

effects.value: Action; detect undead within 60 feet not behind total cover or protected from divination magic

name: Eyes of the Grave
description: As an action, you can detect the presence of undead within 60 feet that are not behind total cover or protected from divination magic. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier, regaining all uses after a long rest.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Grave Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Action; curse one creature within 30 feet; the next time you or an ally hits it with an attack, the target has vulnerability to all of that attack's damage; curse then ends

name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to curse a creature within 30 feet. The next time you or an ally hits it with an attack, the creature has vulnerability to all of that attack's damage, after which the curse ends.

effects.value: Reaction when you or a visible creature within 30 feet suffers a critical hit; turn it into a normal hit

name: Sentinel at Death's Door
description: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet suffers a critical hit, you can use your reaction to turn that hit into a normal hit. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier, regaining all uses after a long rest.

effects.value: +Wisdom_modifier

name: Potent Spellcasting
description: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

name: Keeper of Souls
description: When an enemy dies within 60 feet of you, you or one ally you can see within 60 feet regains hit points equal to the enemy's number of Hit Dice. You can use this feature only once per round.

effects.value: heavy armor
Intimidation or Persuasion

name: Bonus Proficiencies
description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and either the Intimidation or Persuasion skill.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Order Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: When casting a 1st-level-or-higher spell targeting an ally, that ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack against a creature you can see

name: Voice of Authority
description: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher on an ally, that ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack against a creature you can see. The spell must target the ally, and you cannot target yourself with this feature.

effects.value: Action; chosen creatures within 30 feet make Wisdom saves or are charmed until end of your next turn or until damaged; affected creatures drop what they are holding

name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to force creatures of your choice within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature is charmed until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage, and it drops what it is holding.

effects.value: Cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action

name: Embodiment of the Law
description: You can cast Enchantment spells of 1st level or higher as a bonus action instead of an action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

effects.value: Once per turn, add 1d8 psychic damage to a weapon hit; increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 psychic damage. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: When Divine Strike damages a creature, the next attack against it before the start of your next turn deals an additional 2d8 psychic damage

name: Order's Wrath
description: When you deal Divine Strike damage to a creature, you can curse it until the start of your next turn. The next attack made by you or an ally against the cursed creature deals an additional 2d8 psychic damage.

effects.value: One of Insight, Performance, or Persuasion

name: Implement of Peace
description: You gain proficiency in Insight, Performance, or Persuasion.

effects.value: Bond willing creatures within 30 feet for 10 minutes; once per turn, a bonded creature can add 1d4 to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw if within 30 feet of another bonded creature

name: Emboldening Bond
description: You can create a bond among willing creatures within 30 feet. Once per turn, a bonded creature can add a d4 to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made while within 30 feet of another bonded creature; the number of bonded creatures and uses increase with your proficiency bonus.

name: Domain Spells
description: You always have the Peace Domain spells prepared at the specified cleric levels. These spells do not count against the number of cleric spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Action; move up to walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks; heal each creature you pass within 5 feet once

name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement, you can restore hit points to creatures you pass within 5 feet of, without restoring hit points to any creature more than once.

effects.value: Reaction; when a bonded creature is about to take damage, another bonded creature within 30 feet can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it and take the damage instead

name: Protective Bond
description: A creature bonded by Emboldening Bond can use its reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another bonded creature when that creature is about to take damage. The teleporting creature takes the damage instead.

effects.value: +Wisdom_modifier

name: Potent Spellcasting
description: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

effects.value: Emboldening Bond and Protective Bond range increases to 60 feet; creature using Protective Bond gains resistance to the damage it takes

name: Expansive Bond
description: The range of Emboldening Bond and Protective Bond increases to 60 feet. When a bonded creature uses Protective Bond to take another creature's damage, it gains resistance to that damage.

heavy armor

description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

effects.value: Gain darkvision out to 300 feet
Action; grant your darkvision to willing creatures within 10 feet for 1 hour

name: Eyes of Night
description: You gain darkvision out to 300 feet. As an action, you can share this darkvision with a number of willing creatures within 10 feet equal to your Wisdom modifier for 1 hour; you can do so once per long rest unless you expend a spell slot to do so again.

effects.value: One touched creature has advantage on its next initiative roll

name: Vigilant Blessing
description: As an action, you can give one creature you touch advantage on its next initiative roll. The benefit ends immediately after the roll or when you use this feature again.

effects.value: Action; create 30-foot-radius sphere centered on you for 1 minute; when a creature ends its turn in the sphere, grant it 1d6 + cleric level temporary hit points or end one effect causing it to be charmed or frightened

name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to create a sphere of twilight for 1 minute. Whenever a creature ends its turn in the sphere, you can grant it temporary hit points or end one effect causing it to be charmed or frightened.

effects.value: Bonus action while in dim light or darkness; gain flying speed equal to walking speed for 1 minute

name: Steps of Night
description: While in dim light or darkness, you can use a bonus action to magically gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

effects.value: Once per turn, add 1d8 radiant damage to a weapon hit; increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14

name: Divine Strike
description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. The extra damage increases to 2d8 at cleric level 14.

effects.value: You and your allies have half cover while within your Twilight Sanctuary sphere

name: Twilight Shroud
description: The sphere created by Twilight Sanctuary grants half cover to you and your allies while you are in the sphere.

effects.value: Learn one additional druid cantrip

name: Bonus Cantrip
description: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

name: Natural Recovery
description: During a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to no more than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can use this feature once per long rest.

effects.value: Gain land-specific spells at druid levels 3, 5, 7, and 9; spells are always prepared and do not count against prepared druid spells

name: Circle Spells
description: You gain additional spells based on the type of land you choose, and these spells are always prepared without counting against your prepared druid spells. You choose your land type from arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, or swamp.

effects.value: Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and nonmagical plant-based movement hazards; advantage on saves against magically created or manipulated plants that impede movement

name: Land's Stride
description: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement, and you can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed or damaged by their thorns, spines, or similar hazards. You also have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement.

effects.value: Immune to charmed and frightened conditions caused by elementals and fey; immune to poison and disease

name: Nature's Ward
description: You cannot be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

effects.value: Beast or plant attacking you makes Wisdom save; on failure chooses another target or attack misses; on success immune to this effect for 24 hours

name: Nature's Sanctuary
description: When a beast or plant creature attacks you, it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, it must choose another target or the attack automatically misses; on a successful save, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

effects.value: Use Wild Shape as a bonus action

name: Combat Wild Shape
description: You can use Wild Shape as a bonus action, and while transformed you can expend a spell slot as a bonus action to regain hit points. The healing is 1d8 per level of the spell slot expended.

effects.value: Maximum beast CR 1 at druid level 2; increases to CR 2 at level 6, CR 3 at level 9, and CR 4 at level 12; ignore the normal maximum CR restriction

name: Circle Forms
description: You can use Wild Shape to transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as 1, ignoring the normal maximum CR restriction. Your maximum beast challenge rating increases as you gain druid levels.

effects.value: Beast-form attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage

name: Primal Strike
description: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

effects.value: Expend two Wild Shape uses to transform into an air, earth, fire, or water elemental

name: Elemental Wild Shape
description: You can expend two uses of Wild Shape at the same time to transform into an air, earth, fire, or water elemental.

effects.value: Cast Alter Self at will without expending a spell slot

name: Thousand Forms
description: You can cast Alter Self at will, without expending a spell slot.

effects.value: The healed creature also gains temporary hit points equal to the number of dice spent

name: Balm of the Summer Court
description: You can use healing fey energy to restore hit points to creatures you can see within 120 feet. You have a pool of d6s equal to half your druid level (rounded up), and can expend dice to heal a creature and grant it temporary hit points.

effects.value: +5 while inside the sphere
Create a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet during a short or long rest; sphere is stationary and lasts until the rest ends

name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
description: During a short or long rest, you can create a protective sphere of shadow and light around your camp. You and your allies gain a bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) and Wisdom (Perception) checks while within the sphere.

effects.value: Bonus action; teleport yourself or one willing creature you can see up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see

name: Hidden Paths
description: You can teleport yourself or a willing creature you can see up to 30 feet as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once) per long rest, or expend a spell slot of any level to use it again.

effects.value: At the end of a short rest, cast Dream, Scrying, or Teleportation Circle without a spell slot or material components; alternatively teleport yourself and willing creatures to a location associated with your last long rest

name: Walker in Dreams
description: When you finish a short rest, you can cast one of the listed spells without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. You can also use this feature to teleport yourself and willing creatures to a location associated with your last long rest.

effects.value: Learn Sylvan; beasts understand your speech and you can interpret their noises and motions

name: Speech of the Woods
description: You learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. Beasts can understand your speech, and you gain the ability to interpret their noises and motions.

You and allies in the aura have advantage on ability checks to detect creatures; when you cast a spell using a spell slot to restore hit points, each creature of your choice in the aura regains hit points equal to your druid level

name: Spirit Totem
description: As a bonus action, you can summon an incorporeal spirit in an unoccupied space within 60 feet. The spirit creates an aura with a 30-foot radius and grants a benefit based on whether you choose Bear, Hawk, or Unicorn.

effects.value: +2_hit_points_per_Hit_Die
Natural weapon attacks of beasts and fey summoned or created by your spells count as magical

name: Mighty Summoner
description: Beasts and fey summoned or created by your spells gain additional hit points and have their natural weapon attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

name: Guardian Spirit
description: When a beast or fey you summoned or created ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, it regains hit points equal to half your druid level.

effects.value: Trigger when reduced to 0 hit points or incapacitated against your will; cast Conjure Animals as a 9th-level spell without components; summoned beasts appear within 20 feet and protect you

name: Faithful Summons
description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points or incapacitated against your will, you can immediately gain the benefits of Conjure Animals as if cast at 9th level. The summoned creatures appear within 20 feet of you and protect you.

name: Circle Spells
description: You gain access to additional spells at the druid levels specified. These spells are always prepared and count as druid spells for you.

effects.value: Reaction; target takes 1d4 necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save; damage increases to 1d6 at druid level 6, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 14

name: Halo of Spores
description: You are surrounded by invisible, necrotic spores. When a creature you can see moves into a space within 10 feet of you or starts its turn there, you can use your reaction to deal necrotic damage to it unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw.

effects.value: Action; gain 4 temporary hit points per druid level; Halo of Spores damage doubles; melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage; lasts 10 minutes or until temporary hit points are lost
While Symbiotic Entity is active, melee weapon hits deal +1d6 necrotic damage

name: Symbiotic Entity
description: You can expend a use of Wild Shape to awaken your spores rather than transform. You gain temporary hit points, and your Halo of Spores damage and melee weapon attacks deal additional necrotic damage while the effect lasts.

effects.value: Reaction when a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 feet; animate it as a zombie with 1 hit point; it acts immediately after your turn and lasts 1 hour

name: Fungal Infestation
description: When a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to animate it as a zombie. The zombie acts immediately after your turn and lasts for 1 hour.

effects.value: Bonus action while Symbiotic Entity is active; create a 10-foot cube of spores within 30 feet; creatures entering or starting their turn there take Halo of Spores damage without a reaction; cube lasts 1 minute or until you use this feature again

name: Spreading Spores
description: While Symbiotic Entity is active, you can use a bonus action to create a 10-foot cube of spores at a point within 30 feet. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the cube take your Halo of Spores damage, with no reaction required.

effects.value: Immune to blinded, deafened, frightened, and poisoned conditions
Critical hits against you become normal hits
Resistance to poison damage

name: Fungal Body
description: You cannot be blinded, deafened, frightened, or poisoned, and critical hits against you become normal hits. You also gain resistance to poison damage.

effects.value: Star map can serve as a druidic focus
Guiding Bolt is always prepared and does not count against prepared druid spells

name: Star Map
description: You create or discover a star map that serves as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells. You learn Guiding Bolt, which is always prepared and does not count against your prepared spells, and can cast it without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

effects.value: Bonus action; expend one Wild Shape use; lasts 10 minutes; choose Archer (bonus-action ranged spell attack dealing radiant damage), Chalice (when casting a healing spell using a spell slot, heal another creature within 30 feet), or Dragon (minimum 10 on Intelligence or Wisdom checks to maintain concentration on a spell)

name: Starry Form
description: As a bonus action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to take on a starry form rather than transform into a beast. You choose a constellation that grants a special benefit, and the form lasts for 10 minutes.

effects.value: Reaction; add 1d6 to a creature's attack roll, ability check, or saving throw within 30 feet
Reaction; subtract 1d6 from a creature's attack roll, ability check, or saving throw within 30 feet

name: Cosmic Omen
description: After finishing a long rest, you roll a die to determine whether you receive a Weal or Woe omen. You can use your reaction to add or subtract a d6 from a creature's attack roll, ability check, or saving throw within 30 feet.

effects.value: Archer constellation damage increases to 2d8
Gain flying speed of 20 feet and can hover while in Dragon constellation

name: Twinkling Constellations
description: Your Starry Form constellations improve. Archer and Chalice damage or healing increases to 2d8, and Dragon form grants a flying speed and the ability to hover.

effects.value: While Starry Form is active, gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage

name: Full of Stars
description: While in Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal and gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Circle Spells
description: You gain additional spells at the druid levels specified. These spells are always prepared and count as druid spells for you.

effects.value: Summon spirit in unoccupied space within 30 feet; spirit acts immediately after your turn; lasts 1 hour or until reduced to 0 hit points; uses your bonus action to command it

name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
description: You can expend a use of Wild Shape to summon a Wildfire Spirit in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. The spirit acts immediately after your turn, follows your commands, and lasts for 1 hour or until reduced to 0 hit points.

effects.value: +1d8 once per turn while Wildfire Spirit is summoned
When casting a spell that deals fire damage or restores hit points, the spell can originate from your space or your Wildfire Spirit's space

name: Enhanced Bond
description: Your bond with your Wildfire Spirit enhances your fire and healing spells. While your spirit is summoned, you can add a d8 to one damage or healing roll of a spell, and spells you cast can originate from your space or the spirit's space.

effects.value: Reaction; deal 2d10 + Wisdom modifier fire damage to a creature entering the flame's space

name: Cauterizing Flames
description: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or your Wildfire Spirit, a harmless flame appears in its space. When a creature enters that space, you can use your reaction to either heal it or deal fire damage to it.

effects.value: When reduced to 0 hit points while Wildfire Spirit is within 120 feet, dismiss the spirit and regain half your hit point maximum

name: Blazing Revival
description: If your Wildfire Spirit is within 120 feet when you are reduced to 0 hit points and fall unconscious, you can cause the spirit to disappear and regain half your hit points.

name: Improved Critical
description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

effects.value: +half_proficiency_bonus_rounded_up_when_not_proficient
+Strength_modifier

name: Remarkable Athlete
description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution checks that do not already use your proficiency bonus. You also gain a running long jump and high jump distance increased by your Strength modifier.

effects.value: Choose one additional Fighting Style option

name: Additional Fighting Style
description: You can choose a second Fighting Style option.

name: Superior Critical
description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.

name: Survivor
description: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points if you have no more than half your hit points remaining and at least 1 hit point. You regain 5 + your Constitution modifier hit points.

effects.value: Learn three maneuvers; learn two additional maneuvers at fighter levels 7, 10, and 15; superiority die becomes d10 at level 10 and d12 at level 18

name: Combat Superiority
description: You learn three maneuvers of your choice, which use superiority dice to enhance attacks, defenses, and other combat actions. You gain four d8 superiority dice, which are expended when used and regained after a short or long rest.

effects.value: one type of artisan's tools

name: Student of War
description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

name: Know Your Enemy
description: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with a creature outside combat, you can learn whether it is your equal, superior, or inferior in two characteristics of your choice from a specified list.

effects.value: Superiority dice become d10

description: Your superiority dice become d10s.

name: Relentless
description: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain one superiority die.

effects.value: Superiority dice become d12

description: Your superiority dice become d12s.

effects.value: Learn wizard spells; Intelligence is spellcasting ability; spells known and spell slots follow the Eldritch Knight progression; most spells must be abjuration or evocation

name: Spellcasting
description: You learn to cast wizard spells, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. Most of your spells must be from the abjuration or evocation schools, with limited exceptions as you gain levels.

name: Weapon Bond
description: You perform a ritual to bond with one weapon, or two weapons at higher fighter levels. You cannot be disarmed of a bonded weapon unless incapacitated, and you can summon it to your hand as a bonus action if it is on the same plane of existence.

name: War Magic

effects.value: A creature hit by your weapon attack has disadvantage on its next saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn

name: Eldritch Strike
description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

effects.value: When using Action Surge, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see before or after the additional action

name: Arcane Charge

effects.value: After casting a spell with your action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action

name: Improved War Magic
description: When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

effects.value: Learn two Arcane Shot options; learn one additional option at fighter levels 7, 10, 15, and 18; apply an option to one arrow fired from a shortbow or longbow once per turn

name: Arcane Shot
description: You learn two Arcane Shot options and can imbue ammunition with magical effects when firing a shortbow or longbow. You can use Arcane Shot twice per short or long rest, and learn additional options at higher fighter levels.

effects.value: Nonmagical arrows fired from a shortbow or longbow count as magical

name: Magic Arrow

effects.value: After missing with a magic arrow, use a bonus action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 feet of the original target

name: Curving Shot
description: When you make an attack roll with a magic arrow and miss, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 feet of the original target.

name: Ever-Ready Shot
description: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Arcane Shot remaining, you regain one use.

Mounting or dismounting costs 5 feet of movement; can mount or dismount while prone

name: Born to the Saddle
description: You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid falling off your mount, and mounting or dismounting a creature costs you only 5 feet of movement. You can also mount or dismount while prone without spending extra movement.

name: Unwavering Mark
description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark it until the end of your next turn. A marked creature has disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you, and you can make a special bonus-action attack against it if it damages someone else.

name: Warding Maneuver
description: When you or a creature you can see within 5 feet is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to roll a d8 and add it to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has resistance to the attack's damage.

effects.value: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when moving at least 5 feet within your reach; a hit with such an attack reduces the creature's speed to 0 for the rest of the turn

name: Hold the Line
description: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach. If you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, its speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.

effects.value: Once per turn, after moving at least 10 feet straight toward a target and hitting it with a melee weapon attack, force a Strength save or knock it prone

name: Ferocious Charger
description: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. You can use this feature once per turn.

effects.value: Make one opportunity attack on each creature's turn other than yours without using your reaction

name: Vigilant Defender
description: You can make one opportunity attack on every creature's turn, except your own, without using your reaction.

Alternatively, learn one language

description: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language.

effects.value: Advantage until end of current turn

name: Fighting Spirit
description: As a bonus action, you can give yourself advantage on all weapon attack rolls until the end of the current turn and gain temporary hit points. You can use this feature three times per long rest, and regain one use when you roll initiative if none remain.

effects.value: Wisdom; if already proficient, choose Intelligence or Charisma instead
+Wisdom_modifier

name: Tireless Spirit
description: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, you regain one use.

name: Strength Before Death
description: When you take damage that reduces you to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to delay falling unconscious and immediately take an extra turn. At the end of that turn, you fall unconscious if still at 0 hit points.

name: Rallying Cry
description: When you use Second Wind, you can choose up to three creatures within 60 feet that are allied with you. Each chosen creature regains hit points equal to your fighter level.

effects.value: Persuasion; if already proficient, choose another skill

name: Royal Envoy
description: You gain proficiency in Persuasion. If you already have it, you gain proficiency in one other skill of your choice. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

effects.value: When using Action Surge, one ally within 60 feet can use its reaction to make one weapon attack; at fighter level 18, choose two allies

name: Inspiring Surge
description: When you use Action Surge, you can choose one ally within 60 feet to make one melee or ranged weapon attack with its reaction. At fighter level 18, you can choose two allies.

effects.value: Reaction when a creature attacks an ally within 5 feet; grant the ally advantage on saving throws and a bonus to AC equal to your Charisma modifier against the triggering attack

name: Bulwark
description: When a creature you can see attacks an ally within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to grant that ally a bonus to AC against the attack. You can also grant the ally advantage on saving throws against effects that allow a saving throw.

effects.value: Bonus action to manifest echo within 15 feet; AC 14 + proficiency bonus; 1 hit point; immune to conditions; disappears if more than 30 feet away at end of turn; can move it up to 30 feet as a bonus action; teleport by swapping places at a cost of 15 feet of movement
When taking the Attack action, make attacks from your space or the echo's space; make opportunity attacks from the echo's space using your reaction

name: Manifest Echo
description: You can create a magical echo of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet. You can move the echo, swap places with it, make attacks from its position, and use it as the origin of opportunity attacks.

effects.value: When taking the Attack action, make one additional melee attack from the echo's space

name: Unleash Incarnation
description: When you take the Attack action, you can make one additional melee attack from your echo's position. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum once) per long rest.

effects.value: Action; see and hear through echo for up to 10 minutes; echo can be up to 1,000 feet away; you are deaf and blind to your own senses while using it

name: Echo Avatar
description: You can temporarily transfer your consciousness into your echo, allowing you to see and hear through it. During this time, you are deaf and blind to your own surroundings.

effects.value: Reaction when a creature you can see is about to be hit; teleport echo to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that creature and make the attack target the echo instead

name: Shadow Martyr
description: When a creature you can see is about to be hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to teleport your echo to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. The attack targets the echo instead.

name: Reclaim Potential
description: When your echo is destroyed, you gain temporary hit points. You can gain these temporary hit points a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum once) per long rest.

effects.value: Manifest and maintain two echoes simultaneously

name: Legion of One
description: You can create two echoes simultaneously. When you roll initiative and have no uses of Unleash Incarnation remaining, you regain one use.
