name: Protective Field
description: When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction and expend a Psionic Energy die to reduce the damage by the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier.

effects.value: Expend one Psionic Energy die after a weapon hit against a target within 30 feet to deal force damage equal to the die roll + Intelligence modifier

name: Psionic Strike
description: Once on each of your turns, immediately after you hit a target within 30 feet with a weapon attack, you can expend a Psionic Energy die to deal additional force damage.

effects.value: Action; move one loose object weighing up to 1,000 pounds or one willing creature other than yourself up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see

name: Telekinetic Movement
description: You can move one loose object or willing creature with your mind. You can use this feature once without expending a Psionic Energy die, and can use it again by expending a die.

effects.value: Bonus action; gain flying speed equal to twice your walking speed until end of current turn
When dealing Psionic Strike damage, force the target to make a Strength save or be knocked prone or moved up to 10 feet horizontally

name: Telekinetic Adept
description: You gain the ability to move yourself or a creature with telekinetic force and can briefly fly after using Action Surge.

name: Bulwark of Force
description: You can use a bonus action to protect yourself and other creatures with half cover. You can use this feature once per long rest, or expend a Psionic Energy die to use it again.

effects.value: Cast Telekinesis without components; Intelligence is spellcasting ability; while concentrating, make one weapon attack as a bonus action on each turn

name: Telekinetic Master
description: You can cast Telekinesis without components, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. While concentrating on the spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Open Hand Technique
description: Whenever you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of three effects: prevent its reactions, knock it prone, or push it away.

name: Wholeness of Body
description: You can use an action to regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You can use this feature once per long rest.

effects.value: Gain Sanctuary effect after a long rest; ends early if you attack, cast a spell, or deal damage

name: Tranquility
description: At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of the Sanctuary spell until the start of your next long rest. The spell ends early if you attack, cast a spell, or deal damage.

effects.value: After applying vibrations with an unarmed strike, use an action within a number of days equal to monk level to end them; target makes Constitution save or drops to 0 hit points, taking 10d10 necrotic damage on success

name: Quivering Palm
description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to create imperceptible vibrations in its body. You can later use an action to end the vibrations, forcing a Constitution saving throw; on a failure, the creature drops to 0 hit points.

effects.value: Spend 2 ki points to cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace, or Silence without material components
Learn Minor Illusion

name: Shadow Arts
description: You can spend 2 ki points to cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace, or Silence without material components. You also learn the Minor Illusion cantrip.

effects.value: Bonus action; teleport up to 60 feet between spaces in dim light or darkness; gain advantage on the first melee attack before end of turn

name: Shadow Step
description: While in dim light or darkness, you can teleport up to 60 feet as a bonus action to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness. You then have advantage on the first melee attack you make before the end of the turn.

effects.value: Action in dim light or darkness; become invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or enter bright light

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use an action to become invisible. You remain invisible until you make an attack, cast a spell, or enter an area of bright light.

description: When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack made by a creature other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.

name: Hour of Reaping
description: As an action, you can frighten creatures of your choice within 30 feet that can see you. Each creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

name: Mastery of Death
description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can spend 1 ki point to have 1 hit point instead.

effects.value: Expend 1–10 ki points; target takes 2d10 necrotic damage per ki point spent on a failed Constitution save, or half damage on success

name: Touch of the Long Death
description: As an action, you can touch one creature within 5 feet and expend 1 to 10 ki points. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking necrotic damage based on the ki points spent on a failure, or half as much on a success.

effects.value: Make ranged spell attack with range 30 feet; damage equals Martial Arts die + Dexterity modifier; counts as a monk weapon attack for features that require one

name: Radiant Sun Bolt
description: You can make ranged spell attacks with bolts of radiant energy. The attacks have a range of 30 feet and deal radiant damage based on your Martial Arts die.

effects.value: After Attack action, spend 2 ki points to cast Burning Hands as a bonus action; spend 1 additional ki point per spell level above 1st, up to 6th level

name: Searing Arc Strike
description: Immediately after taking the Attack action, you can spend 2 ki points to cast Burning Hands as a bonus action. You can spend additional ki points to cast it at a higher level.

effects.value: Action; create 20-foot-radius sphere at a point within 150 feet; creatures make Constitution saves or take 2d6 radiant damage, half on success; spend up to 3 ki points to increase damage by 2d6 per ki point

name: Searing Sunburst
description: You can create a ball of radiant energy and hurl it to a point within 150 feet. Creatures within 20 feet of that point make Constitution saving throws, taking radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

effects.value: Emit bright light in 30-foot radius and dim light for another 30 feet; can suppress or restore the light as a bonus action
Reaction when hit by a melee attack; deal 5 + Wisdom_modifier radiant damage to the attacker

name: Sun Shield
description: You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for another 30 feet. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal radiant damage to it.

+2 while wielding a kensei weapon and making an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action

As a bonus action, make ranged attacks with a kensei ranged weapon deal an extra 1d4 damage until end of turn

name: Path of the Kensei
description: You choose two types of weapons to be your kensei weapons, one melee and one ranged. You gain benefits when wielding them, including a bonus to AC when making an unarmed strike and the ability to make them magical.

effects.value: Kensei weapons count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage
Once per turn, spend 1 ki point to deal extra damage equal to one Martial Arts die when hitting with a kensei weapon

name: One with the Blade
description: Your kensei weapons count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. You also gain the ability to spend ki to deal extra damage with a kensei weapon.

effects.value: Bonus action; spend up to 3 ki points to grant a kensei weapon +1 per ki point to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute

name: Sharpen the Blade
description: As a bonus action, you can spend up to 3 ki points to grant one kensei weapon a bonus to attack and damage rolls. The bonus lasts for 1 minute, and the weapon must not already be magical with a bonus to those rolls.

effects.value: Once per turn, reroll a missed attack with a monk weapon

name: Unerring Accuracy
description: Once on each of your turns, when you miss with a weapon attack using a monk weapon, you can reroll the attack roll.

effects.value: Bonus action; summon for 10 minutes; use Wisdom instead of Strength for Strength checks and saves; unarmed strikes can deal force damage and reach 5 feet farther than normal

name: Arms of the Astral Self
description: You can spend 2 ki points as a bonus action to summon the arms of your astral self for 10 minutes. While summoned, you can use Wisdom instead of Strength for Strength checks and saving throws, and your unarmed strikes can deal force damage with extended reach.

effects.value: Bonus action; summon for 10 minutes; gain darkvision 120 feet or extend existing darkvision by 60 feet; see through magical and nonmagical darkness; advantage on Insight and Intimidation checks; telepathically communicate with creatures within 60 feet

name: Visage of the Astral Self
description: You can summon the visage of your astral self for 1 ki point. While active, you can see normally in darkness, gain advantage on Insight and Intimidation checks, and communicate telepathically.

effects.value: When taking acid, cold, fire, force, or lightning damage, use reaction to reduce it by 1d10 + Wisdom_modifier
While astral arms are summoned, once on each of your turns deal one additional Martial Arts die of force damage when hitting with astral arms

name: Body of the Astral Self
description: When both your astral arms and visage are summoned, you gain additional benefits: deflect energy, enhanced damage, and the ability to use your reaction to reduce damage.

effects.value: While all three astral forms are summoned, astral arms deal two additional Martial Arts dice of force damage on a hit
Summon arms, visage, and body simultaneously for 5 ki points

name: Awakened Astral Self
description: When you summon your astral arms, visage, and body, you gain additional benefits. You can summon all three parts simultaneously for 5 ki points, and your astral arms deal additional damage.

effects.value: Hand of Healing ends one disease or one of blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned conditions
A creature damaged by Hand of Harm must succeed on a Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of your next turn

name: Physician's Touch
description: Your Hand of Healing can end one disease or one condition affecting the target. Your Hand of Harm can also poison a creature until the end of your next turn.

effects.value: When using Flurry of Blows, replace each attack with Hand of Healing without spending ki
Once during each Flurry of Blows, use Hand of Harm without spending ki

name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
description: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace each attack with a use of Hand of Healing without spending ki points. You can also use Hand of Harm once during each Flurry of Blows without spending a ki point.

effects.value: Revive a creature that died within the last 24 hours; restore it to life with hit points from the healing roll; remove one of blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned conditions

name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy

name: Draconic Disciple

name: Breath of the Dragon

effects.value: When using Step of the Wind, gain flying speed equal to walking speed until end of turn

name: Wings Unfurled
description: When you use Step of the Wind, you can unfurl spectral dragon wings and gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

When creating aura, choose to frighten creatures of your choice within it; Wisdom save or frightened until end of your next turn

name: Aspect of the Wyrm
description: You can create an aura of draconic energy that grants you and chosen creatures resistance to a damage type of your choice. The aura also frightens or strengthens creatures depending on the option you choose.

effects.value: Gain blindsight out to 10 feet
Aspect of the Wyrm aura expands to 30 feet

name: Rend Mind
description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage with your Psychic Blades, force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw or become stunned.

effects.value: alchemist's supplies

name: Tool Proficiency
description: You gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with another type of artisan's tools of your choice.

name: Alchemist Spells
description: You always have certain spells prepared at specific Artificer levels. These spells count as Artificer spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Choose or randomly determine Healing (2d4 + Intelligence modifier HP), Swiftness (+10 feet walking speed), Resilience (+1 AC), Boldness (1d4 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws), Flight (10 feet flying speed), or Transformation (altered physical appearance).

Expend one spell slot of 1st level or higher and use an action to create an additional elixir with a chosen effect; each elixir requires an empty flask and lasts until drunk or the end of your next long rest.
Drinking an experimental elixir requires a bonus action.

name: Experimental Elixir
description: Whenever you finish a long rest, you magically produce an experimental elixir in an empty flask, rolling on the Experimental Elixir table to determine its effect. You can create additional elixirs by expending spell slots, choosing their effects instead of rolling randomly.

effects.value: Intelligence modifier
Add Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of a spell dealing acid, fire, necrotic, or poison damage.
Must use alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus when casting the qualifying spell.

name: Alchemical Savant
description: You develop greater mastery over magical chemicals, allowing you to enhance certain spells. When casting a qualifying spell using alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus, you add your Intelligence modifier to one roll of that spell.

effects.value: Cast without expending a spell slot or preparing the spell, using alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus.

name: Restorative Reagents
description: Your experimental elixirs provide additional protection to their drinkers. You can also cast Lesser Restoration without expending a spell slot or preparing the spell a limited number of times.

effects.value: Resistance to acid damage and poison damage.
Immunity to the poisoned condition.
Cast Greater Restoration and Heal without expending spell slots or preparing the spells, using alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus.

name: Chemical Mastery
description: Your extensive exposure to chemicals grants resistance to acid and poison damage and immunity to the poisoned condition. You can also cast Greater Restoration and Heal without expending spell slots or preparing the spells, once each per long rest.

smith's tools
Crafting time for nonmagical and magical armor is halved.

name: Tools of the Trade
description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools. You also learn to craft armor more efficiently, reducing the time required to craft nonmagical or magical armor by half.

name: Armorer Spells
description: You always have certain spells prepared at specific Artificer levels. These spells count as Artificer spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Transform a suit of worn armor into Arcane Armor using an action and smith's tools.
Ignore the armor's Strength requirement while wearing Arcane Armor.
Arcane Armor can be used as a spellcasting focus for Artificer spells.
Armor cannot be removed against your will; it covers the entire body and can replace missing limbs.
Don or doff Arcane Armor using an action; deploy or retract its helmet using a bonus action.

name: Arcane Armor
description: You can transform a suit of armor you are wearing into Arcane Armor using an action while holding smith's tools. The armor ignores Strength requirements, functions as a spellcasting focus, cannot be removed against your will, replaces missing limbs, and can be donned or doffed as an action.

effects.value: Choose Guardian or Infiltrator; change models after a short or long rest using smith's tools.
Use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with the special weapon granted by your armor model.

name: Armor Model
description: You customize your Arcane Armor by selecting the Guardian or Infiltrator model. Each model grants specialized equipment and abilities, and you can change models after finishing a short or long rest while holding smith's tools.

effects.value: Thunder Gauntlets deal 1d8 thunder damage on a hit and count as simple melee weapons when their hands are not holding anything.
A creature hit by a Thunder Gauntlet has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you until the start of your next turn.

effects.count: Temporary hit points equal to half your Artificer level, rounded up

effects.value: At the start of each of your turns, you can gain the temporary hit points; they are lost if you doff the armor.

name: Guardian Model
description: Your armor is designed for frontline combat, granting Thunder Gauntlets and a Defensive Field. Thunder Gauntlets punish enemies who attack creatures other than you, while Defensive Field provides temporary hit points.

effects.value: Lightning Launcher deals 1d6 lightning damage on a hit; once on each of your turns, one hit with it deals an additional 1d6 lightning damage.
+5 feet
Advantage while wearing the Infiltrator armor.
The Lightning Launcher is mounted on a gauntlet or chest and has a range of 90 feet.

name: Infiltrator Model
description: Your armor is designed for stealth, mobility, and ranged combat. It grants a Lightning Launcher, enhanced movement speed, and advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

effects.value: Make two attacks instead of one when taking the Attack action on your turn.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

effects.value: Armor chest piece, boots, helmet, and special weapon count as separate items for infusions; each can hold one infusion.
Infusions transfer when changing the Arcane Armor model.

name: Armor Modifications
description: Your Arcane Armor can be modified using your Artificer infusions, with its armor, boots, helmet, and special weapon counting as separate items. Each component can hold one infusion, and your maximum number of infused items increases by two, provided those additional items are part of your Arcane Armor.

effects.value: When a Huge or smaller creature you can see ends its turn within 30 feet, use your reaction to force a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC; on a failure, pull it up to 30 feet toward you into an unoccupied space. If it ends within 5 feet, make a melee weapon attack against it as part of the reaction.
A creature damaged by your Lightning Launcher glows until the start of your next turn, sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius, and has disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
The next attack roll against a creature glowing from your Lightning Launcher has advantage.
The next attack that hits a creature glowing from your Lightning Launcher deals an additional 1d6 lightning damage.

name: Perfected Armor
description: Your Arcane Armor gains additional benefits depending on its model. Guardian armor can pull enemies toward you and allow a melee attack, while Infiltrator armor disrupts enemies and improves subsequent attacks against them.

effects.value: woodcarver's tools

name: Tool Proficiency
description: You gain proficiency with woodcarver's tools. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with another type of artisan's tools of your choice.

name: Artillerist Spells
description: You always have certain spells prepared at specific Artificer levels. These spells count as Artificer spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Use an action and woodcarver's tools or smith's tools to create a Small or Tiny magical cannon in an unoccupied space within 5 feet; it lasts 1 hour or until destroyed.
AC 18; hit points equal to five times your Artificer level; immune to poison and psychic damage; occupies its space and can be moved by carrying it or having it move.
Use a bonus action to activate the cannon if it is within 60 feet; it can be activated immediately after creation.
Exhales fire in a 15-foot cone; creatures make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d8 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable unattended objects ignite.
Makes a ranged spell attack against a creature or object within 120 feet; on a hit, deals 2d8 force damage and pushes a creature up to 5 feet away.
Emits positive energy, granting the cannon and each chosen creature within 10 feet temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).
The cannon can be moved up to 15 feet as part of the bonus action used to activate it.

name: Eldritch Cannon
description: You learn to create a magical cannon using woodcarver's tools or smith's tools. You can create a Small or Tiny cannon, choose its form, and activate it using a bonus action; you can create one for free after a long rest or expend a spell slot to create another.

effects.value: Transform a wand, staff, or rod into an Arcane Firearm using woodcarver's tools after a long rest; the sigils last indefinitely until placed on another item.
Arcane Firearm can be used as a spellcasting focus for Artificer spells.
When casting an Artificer spell through the firearm, roll 1d8 and add the result to one damage roll of the spell.

name: Arcane Firearm
description: You can transform a wand, staff, or rod into an Arcane Firearm by carving special sigils into it using woodcarver's tools after finishing a long rest. It functions as a spellcasting focus and enhances the damage of Artificer spells cast through it.

effects.value: All Eldritch Cannon damage rolls increase by 1d8.

Use an action while within 60 feet of your cannon to destroy it and force each creature within 20 feet to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 3d8 force damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Explosive Cannon
description: Your Eldritch Cannons become more destructive, increasing their damage and allowing you to detonate a cannon to damage nearby creatures. The detonation destroys the cannon.

effects.value: You and your allies have half cover while within 10 feet of an Eldritch Cannon you created.
Create two cannons with the same action by expending separate spell slots; you cannot create a third cannon while both exist.
Activate both cannons using the same bonus action.

name: Fortified Position
description: Your Eldritch Cannons create protective fields that grant half cover to you and your allies. You can also maintain two cannons simultaneously and activate both with the same bonus action.

name: Tool Proficiency
description: You gain proficiency with smith's tools and martial weapons. If you already have proficiency with smith's tools, you gain proficiency with another type of artisan's tools of your choice. You also learn to craft weapons more efficiently, reducing the time required to craft nonmagical or magical weapons by half.

name: Battle Smith Spells
description: You always have certain spells prepared at specific Artificer levels. These spells count as Artificer spells for you but do not count against the number of spells you can prepare.

effects.value: Use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack rolls with magic weapons.
Use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for damage rolls with magic weapons.
Any weapon with which you are proficient can be used as a spellcasting focus for Artificer spells.

name: Battle Ready
description: Your combat training and magical experimentation allow you to use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls when using a magic weapon. You can also use any weapon with which you are proficient as a spellcasting focus for your Artificer spells.

effects.value: Create a Medium construct companion using smith's tools; it has statistics based on your Artificer level and proficiency bonus.
The Steel Defender shares your initiative, takes its turn immediately after yours, and can move and use its reaction independently.
It takes the Dodge action by default; use a bonus action to command it to take another action, such as Attack, Dash, Disengage, Help, Hide, or Search.
The Steel Defender makes a melee weapon attack using your spell attack modifier; on a hit, it deals force damage based on your proficiency bonus.
The Steel Defender can repair itself or another construct or object within 5 feet using an action, restoring hit points equal to 2d8 + your Intelligence modifier.
When a creature within 5 feet of the Steel Defender is attacked, it can use its reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll if the target is a creature other than itself.
If destroyed within the last hour, you can use smith's tools as an action to revive it with full hit points, provided you are within 5 feet of it and expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher.
If the Steel Defender dies, you can create a new one at the end of a long rest using smith's tools.

name: Steel Defender
description: You create a loyal mechanical companion that fights alongside you and obeys your commands. The Steel Defender acts on your initiative, can move and use its reaction independently, and can be commanded to take actions using your bonus action.

effects.value: Make two attacks instead of one when taking the Attack action on your turn.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

effects.value: When you hit a target with a magic weapon attack or your Steel Defender hits a target, deal an additional 2d6 force damage.
Instead of dealing force damage, choose a creature or object you can see within 30 feet of the target; it regains 2d6 hit points.
You can use Arcane Jolt no more than once on each of your turns.

name: Arcane Jolt
description: You learn to channel arcane energy through your magic weapon or Steel Defender to damage enemies or heal allies. You can use this ability a limited number of times per long rest.

effects.value: Arcane Jolt's additional force damage increases from 2d6 to 4d6.
+2 to Steel Defender AC
When the Steel Defender uses Deflect Attack, the attacker takes 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier force damage.

name: Improved Defender
description: Your Arcane Jolt becomes more powerful, and your Steel Defender gains improved protection and offensive capabilities. Arcane Jolt's damage and healing increase, the defender gains additional AC, and its defensive reaction damages attackers.
